title: Manyhands JSON v1 host observation
description: The data of a host observe envelope, the read that connects to a host: the key the host presented, and the pin the host has. The host is one the repository's publication remote names, for fetching or for pushing. Nothing is pinned by the read, whatever the host presents. A host that has no pin, and one that presents another key than its pin, are reported as successes: pinned_fingerprint is null for the first and differs from fingerprint for the second.

fetch.description: Whether the publication remote is fetched from this host.

push.description: Whether the publication remote is pushed to this host.

algorithm.description: The algorithm of the key the host presented. With fingerprint it is what host approve and host replace are given.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the key the host presented: SHA256: and the digest of the public key, as a pin holds it.

pinned_algorithm.description: The algorithm of the key the host is pinned to. Null for a host that has no pin.

pinned_fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the key the host is pinned to: what host replace is given as the old fingerprint. Null for a host that has no pin.

reapproval_required.description: The application-wide marker left when the pin registry was lost.
